807.text: 807 avarati f. 'ceasing'. [Cf. Pa. ōramati 'desists': √ ram ] Kho. orói 'sleep' ( < * orori ) whence oréik 'to sleep'. * avaratya -.

5848.html:
5848 tīvrá 'strong, hot, pungent' RV.
    Pa. tibba- 'sharp, eager'; Aś.shah. man. tivre, kāl. tive, gir. tīvo 'zealous'; Pk. tivva- 'strong, fierce, pungent'; Tir. tre 'salt' (but EVP 83 < *tr̥pu- cf. Kho. trup 'salt' < tr̥pra-²). — Ext. with -āla- in Gaw. liwā́lo 'sharp' with *λi- assimilated by following -l- to li-.
    tú, tū́ 'but, now then' RV. See paraṁ tu.

4979.html:
4979 chadana n. 'cover' R., 'leaf' Suśr. [√chad¹]
    Pa. chadana- n. 'thatch, foliage, a leaf'; Si. siyana 'roof'; — Kho. c̣han 'leaf' BelvalkarVol 89 < chādana- leaving c̣h unexpl.
